clock_rule: Only same clock_id monotonic differences; cross-host phases use existing controller roundtrip minus measured body upper envelope. No cross-host epoch subtraction.
ready_boundary: Exact original REQUEST reserved and ready for the dedicated PBS queue
scheduler_queue_wait_scope: PBS manager qtime and stime equal at one-second resolution, not proof of zero subsecond delay
peak_memory_scope: Sampled summed process-tree RSS; not exact physical/cgroup peak and shared pages may be counted repeatedly
pbs_memory_caution: PBS sampled mem covers a narrower scope and is not substituted for supervised process-tree RSS
save_to_adopt_upper_envelope_scope: Conservative B+C nonbody envelope plus same-controller receive-to-executor-adopt; not a one-way transfer measurement
wire_bytes_note: JSON/base64/SSH/network overhead and protocol messages not measured; decoded payload is not wire volume

original_host_reference.comparison_limits: One saved server-host run versus one shared PBS-node run; distinct host/runtime/instrumentation/cache conditions. No speedup or optimized sizing claim.

search_adopt_missing_scope: Single saved-request driver adopts via existing executor/JobStore; no full optimizer search iteration or SEARCH_ADOPT event was fabricated.
